reason: I only find out about things when they pass through my feed or a friend reposts a story, and that already works for me. I am not going to open a separate app to look for plans I never search for in the first place.
objection: Everything is already on Instagram, so this feels like one more app I download, open twice, and forget about by next weekend.
would_change_my_mind: If my friends were actually on it and I saw their names under an event, like a day trip someone already organized, I would join through it instead of the WhatsApp group.
